author: nself

cliCommands.description: Run the nself-ci gate suite and post a GitHub commit status
cliCommands.name: ci

flags.name: artifact
flags.usage: Artifact type to build (only "android" is supported)

flags.name: owner
flags.usage: GitHub owner for --upload (default: from git remote)

flags.name: repo
flags.usage: GitHub repo for --upload (default: from git remote)

flags.name: tag
flags.usage: Release tag to upload to (required with --upload)

flags.name: timeout
flags.usage: Build step timeout in seconds (release builds are slow)

flags.name: upload
flags.usage: Attach the built artifact to a GitHub release via `gh release upload`

flags.name: verbose
flags.usage: Print each command before running

subcommands.name: build
subcommands.summary: Build a signed release artifact locally (Android only)

flags.name: runner
flags.usage: Runner container name (default: <PROJECT>_forgejo_runner)

flags.name: url
flags.usage: Forgejo base URL

subcommands.name: forgejo
subcommands.summary: Show Forgejo server + runner health (ops profile)

flags.name: addr
flags.usage: Listen address (host:port). Port 3845 = nself-ci-serve per F10 port registry

flags.name: allow-unsandboxed
flags.usage: DANGEROUS: run the gate directly on this host when Docker is unavailable, instead of refusing the job. Default: refuse.

flags.name: allowed-repos
flags.usage: Comma-separated or repeatable "owner/repo" allowlist. Default: empty, which rejects every job (fail-closed, no "allow all").

flags.name: concurrency
flags.usage: Max concurrent CI jobs

flags.name: insecure
flags.usage: DANGEROUS: start without a webhook secret (disables signature verification). Default: refuse to start when no secret is configured.

flags.name: secret
flags.usage: HMAC-SHA256 webhook secret (overrides GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET env)

flags.name: timeout
flags.usage: Per-job timeout in seconds

flags.name: verbose
flags.usage: Verbose gate output

flags.name: workdir
flags.usage: Base directory for ephemeral checkout workdirs

subcommands.name: serve
subcommands.summary: Start the nself-ci webhook listener daemon (port 3845)

flags.name: env
flags.usage: Target environment: local

flags.name: gateway
flags.usage: Explicit gateway base URL (e.g. http://host:3761)

flags.name: v
flags.usage: Print each command before running

flags.name: timeout
flags.usage: Per-step timeout in seconds

subcommands.name: run
subcommands.summary: Discover .ci.yaml manifests and run their stages (pipeline)

flags.name: github-url
flags.usage: Repo or org URL runners register against, e.g. https://github.com/nself-org/cli

flags.name: host
flags.usage: SSH target(s) user@host to provision (repeatable). Default: this machine.

flags.name: install-root
flags.usage: Base install directory (default: /opt/actions-runner)

flags.name: instances
flags.usage: Number of runner instances to install on this host

flags.name: labels
flags.usage: Extra labels appended after self-hosted,Linux,X64

flags.name: ssh-key
flags.usage: SSH private key path (default: NSELF_DEPLOY_KEY_PATH or ~/.ssh/id_ed25519)

flags.name: token
flags.usage: GitHub Actions runner registration token (overrides GITHUB_RUNNER_TOKEN env). Never logged.

subcommands.name: nodes provision
subcommands.summary: Install runner dependencies, user, sudoers, and N runner instances

flags.name: host
flags.usage: SSH target(s) user@host to verify (repeatable). Default: this machine.

flags.name: json
flags.usage: Print raw JSON ([]runner.HostReport) instead of the text parity matrix

flags.name: ssh-key
flags.usage: SSH private key path (default: NSELF_DEPLOY_KEY_PATH or ~/.ssh/id_ed25519)

subcommands.name: nodes verify
subcommands.summary: Check host(s) against the dependency manifest and report drift

commands.summary: Run the nself-ci gate suite and post a GitHub commit status

description: Local CI gate runner: detects repo stack (Go/Node/Flutter/Dart), runs lint+test+build, scans secrets with gitleaks, then posts a GitHub commit status (nself-ci) via gh OAuth. Replaces billing-blocked GitHub Actions as the merge gate.
name: ci
